# Natyv AI

> Natyv AI is an AI-native operations agency founded by Damian Schaeffer. We design and deploy voice AI, autonomous workflows, and bespoke agent systems for service businesses - med spas, dental practices, property management, fitness studios, home services, and restaurants. Our productized SaaS platform is MyAgent (separate site at get-myagent.com).

## About

- [About Damian Schaeffer](https://natyv.ai/about): Founder bio. 20+ years in business operations - scaled K&D Management (Cleveland, OH) to 40+ properties; led Sandcastle Community Management (Naples, FL) with 65 employees serving 150+ communities; founded Gulf Pointe Real Estate Group. Educated at The Ohio State University.

## Services

- [Service Catalog](https://natyv.ai/services): 75+ productized AI workflows organized across 6 business functions - Front Desk, Sales, Operations, Finance, Marketing, and Customer Experience.
- [AI Opportunity Assessment](https://natyv.ai/advisory): $500 founding assessment with guided AI interview, 48-hour Opportunity Map, ROI snapshot, quick-win plan, and founder walkthrough. Assessment is credited toward the first Natyv build when the client moves forward within 14 days.
- [Sample Opportunity Report](https://natyv.ai/sample-ai-opportunity-report): Example report showing how a local service business can rank AI opportunities by payoff, setup time, and first implementation priority.

## Products

- [MyAgent](https://get-myagent.com/): Productized SaaS platform - AI voice agents, scheduling, lead intelligence, follow-up automation, payment workflows. Six packages from $99/mo to Enterprise. The platform Natyv AI deploys for white-glove agency engagements.

## Contact
